metadata.policy: Missing inventory locales are provisional UI catalogs seeded from the English source catalog. Existing authored catalogs are preserved and are not marked provisional. Before authoring a listed provisional locale, remove it from provisionalLocales and run the generator without --refresh-provisional to promote its ownership; --refresh-provisional overwrites every locale that remains listed.

translation.method: OpenAI contextual machine translation with localized phrase reuse

sourceExtensions.method: derived from existing contextual catalog messages

dgr.openFormNewTab: Uses the dictionary entries for new, document, and the open imperative

sourceExtensions.method: native-first contextual retranslation with target-language grammar, completed-results, and available explicit-script-family validation

sourceExtensions.notes: Translated by the assistant during the pull request that removed this path from pendingTranslationPaths, not by scripts/translate-ui-catalogs.mjs; the top-level OpenAI method does not describe this round.
